title: Law Lens legal accuracy evaluation data contract

runtimeManifestHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical runtime legal manifest used to pin the governing legal-source snapshot.

documentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw fetched source bytes before text extraction or normalization. This is provenance metadata, not the analyzer-input hash.

publicCase.description: Opaque public proof record. Company, source URL, sector, and split stay private until the locked evaluation is frozen and released.

evaluationTextSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 text passed to analyzePrivacyPolicy after private-corpus loading. It must be verified independently from source.documentSha256.

corpusRef.description: Opaque reference into a private corpus; never a public repository path containing policy text.

evaluationTextSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 evaluation text labeled by this reviewer. It binds the annotation to one immutable document version without exporting the text itself.

reviewerAnnotationBatch.description: Label-only export container for one reviewer's completed annotations. It must retain each annotation's evaluationTextSha256 while excluding policy text, contexts, and source URLs.

evaluationTextSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 evaluation text to which the adjudication applies.

reviewPacketItem.description: Private blinded-review work item. After review, copy only the annotation fields into reviewerAnnotation and omit text, contexts, titles, and other private work material.

text.description: Private analyzer-input text. Never copy this field into reviewerAnnotation or a public case manifest.

reviewPacket.description: Private blinded-review packet. A completed item converts to reviewerAnnotation by copying annotationId, caseId, track, ruleId, reviewerId, synthetic, eligibleForMetrics, reviewMode, documentCompleteness, evaluationTextSha256, legalAsOfDate, rulesetVersion, guidelineVersion, decision, and reviewerConfidence; recordType, schemaVersion, evaluationId, corpusVersion, and runtimeManifestHash come from the packet. No other item field may be copied.

containsExpertLabels.description: Public case manifests are metadata-only and must never carry reviewer or adjudicated labels.

containsFullPolicyText.description: Full policy text remains in the private corpus and review packets only.
